name: settings
description: A six-tooth gear with flowing shoulders and a circular center in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Six solid teeth use matching straight faces and softened roots, expanded independently from the Outline. A circular hub counter leaves a clean single-color silhouette. Opposite points are symmetric about 12,12. Separately authored fill-only study; counters are fixed geometry. Not owner-approved.
